## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-obj-lineitems-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Navigate to private apps

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your HubSpot account. -->
2. Select **Settings** icon (gear icon) in the top navigation bar.
3. <!-- manual: In the left sidebar, navigate to Integrations › Private Apps. -->

## Step 3: Create a new private app

1. Select **Create a private app** in the top-right corner.
2. <!-- manual: On the Basic Info tab, enter a name for your app (e.g., Ballerina Line Items Connector) and optionally a description and logo. -->
3. Select **Scopes**.

## Step 4: Configure required scopes

1. <!-- manual: Add any additional scopes your integration requires (e.g., deal or product scopes for associations). -->

## Step 5: Create the app and copy the access token

1. Select **Create app** in the top-right corner.
2. Review the access token warning dialog and click **Continue creating**.
3. On the app detail page, select **Show token** under **Access token**.
4. <!-- manual: Copy the token; this is your Private App access token (Bearer token) for the connector. -->
